teacher_info.introduction: I graduated form high school in Dublin in 1983, I then went on in 2014 to study teaching with CELTA in International House in Bangkok. I have spent the last 3 years teaching to Thai; Kinder Garten, Primary, and Secondary students. I also have held private lessons for young adults. For the younger learners I use activities to help engage the students, I also use media in the form of Videos. I use a projector to supplement my lessons. For older learners I use role play, and a variety of activities, in conjunction with media. Some of the topics that I use in my lessons include. . . 'What happens next?' I show the students a video, and the video is paused just before the end. The students are split up into three teams of 10, and they compete as teams to guess What happens next? from 3 possible outcomes. This type of lesson is exciting, and entertaining. 'The Quick Brown Fox!' This is a game that is suitable for any grade of student. The sentence 'THE QUICK BROWN FOX JUMPS OVER THE LAZY DOG' is written on the whiteboard. Each student is given the opportunity to recite the alphabet in sequence from A-Z by pointing a pointer at each letter. They are given a time limit of 30 seconds. When the time is up a buzzer sounds. This is a great ice breaker, and it gives the students confidence. 'Let's go shopping' By using a combination of Flash Cards, and media, i teach the students new vocabulary. The vocabulary will include general everyday nouns that we use when shopping for clothes. I then split the students into pairs. I give one student a Flashcard with a picture of a 'shirt' for example. I give the other student play money. Then the students are asked to role play 'shopping for a shirt'. This activity promotes conversation, and develops the student's use of vocabulary. I have experience in teaching beginners, intermediate, and advanced learners. I approach the lesson from the learner's point of view, and structure the lesson to meet the learner's requirements.

Do you want to speak English confidently and naturally? My conversational English classes are designed to help you do just that! Whether you’re preparing for travel, work, or simply improving your everyday communication, this is the perfect place to practice and grow.

Here’s what you’ll gain in our classes:

- Real-life topics that match your interests and goals.
- A relaxed and supportive environment to boost your confidence.
- Personalized feedback to improve your pronunciation, vocabulary, and grammar.
- Fun and meaningful conversations to help you speak like a native.

With 6 years of teaching experience, I’ve worked with students from different countries and levels, so I understand the challenges of learning a new language. My classes are patient, kind, and tailored to your pace.

Let’s take your English skills to the next level—one conversation at a time! Book a class today! ✨

pro_course_detail.title: Afrikaans Spreekvaardighede
pro_course_detail.description:
🌟 Praat Afrikaans met Selfvertroue en Gemak! 🌟

Is jy opgewonde om jou Afrikaans-spreekvaardighede te verbeter? Of jy nou leer vir reis, werk, of persoonlike verbintenisse, my Afrikaanse geselsklasse is ontwerp om jou te help om natuurlik en selfversekerd te kommunikeer.

Wat jy in ons klasse kan verwag:

Interessante gesprekke oor temas wat vir jou belangrik is.
’n Ontspande en vriendelike atmosfeer om jou selfvertroue te bou.
Praktiese woordeskat en uitdrukkings vir alledaagse situasies.
Persoonlike terugvoer om jou uitspraak, grammatika en vloeiendheid te verbeter.
Met my leiding sal jy gemakliker voel om jouself in Afrikaans uit te druk, ongeag jou huidige vlak. Ek skep ’n geduldige, ondersteunende ruimte waar foute deel is van die leerproses.

Laat ons jou Afrikaansvaardighede lewendig maak—een gesprek op ’n slag. Bespreek vandag nog ’n klas! ✨

teacher_info.teaching_style:
My teaching style is very interactive and I offer three types of lessons; conversational lessons, general English lessons, and interview practice.

In my conversational lessons, I come up with topics or I send articles to students for discussion. During our discussion, I will be noting any errors in your speech and I will provide feedback and some resources to help you improve those areas.

In my general English lessons, I teach grammar, vocabulary and pronunciation in the form of a normal structured tutorial including practice activities.

In my interview practice lessons, we will go over common interview questions and some industry-specific questions for the job you are applying for.

pro_course_detail.title: Language & Life Skills Mastery: Practical Conversations for Real-World Success
pro_course_detail.description:
This package is designed to blend language learning with essential life skills, making it appealing to a wide audience. It focuses on practical, everyday conversations and scenarios that are relevant to personal and professional life, ensuring you gain valuable skills while improving your language proficiency.

Package Features:
Real-Life Scenarios: Daily Interactions: Practice language skills through role-playing common daily scenarios such as making appointments, shopping, or handling emergencies.
Professional Situations: Engage in simulations of workplace conversations, including meetings, negotiations, and networking events, tailored to your career interests.
Essential Life Skills: Effective Communication: Learn techniques for clear and confident communication, including negotiation skills, giving presentations, and active listening.
Cultural Etiquette: Gain insights into cultural norms and etiquette, which can be crucial for both personal and professional interactions.
Interactive Challenges: Language and Skills Challenges: Weekly challenges that combine language practice with real-life skills, such as crafting a resume, preparing a pitch, or planning a trip.
Practical Projects: Work on projects that have practical applications, such as creating a personal blog, organizing a virtual event, or writing professional emails.
Personalized Learning: Goal-Oriented Lessons: The content is customized based on your specific goals, whether they are related to career advancement, travel, or personal development.
One-on-One Coaching: Receive personalized feedback and coaching tailored to your needs and interests, ensuring you get the most out of each session.
Engaging Content: Current Events Discussions: Incorporate discussions about current events and trending topics to practice language skills and stay informed about global affairs.
Interactive Media: Utilize multimedia resources like podcasts, videos, and articles to make learning more dynamic and relevant.

pro_course_detail.description:
Learn through the communicative method- This method will enable learners to communicate knowledge and opinions surrounding a topic in the target language.

Learn how to speak and listen in the English language. This will include learning different sub skills ,how to overcome barriers and effective strategies, exercises and activities.

Learn how  to socialise in English. This will include a variety of greeting words and phrases, informal and formal language to match a given situation and how to express thoughts, feelings and ideas.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational classes  (for Generous Students)
pro_course_detail.description:
Learn Through the Communicative Method
This method empowers learners to express knowledge and opinions on various topics in the target language. It prioritizes authentic, meaningful communication, helping students achieve fluency while fostering confidence in using English in real-life contexts.

Speak and Listen in English
Develop essential speaking and listening skills through engaging sub-skill exercises and interactive activities. Gain effective strategies to overcome communication barriers, improve pronunciation, and build fluency. Tailored exercises will enable learners to practice and master these vital skills in an enjoyable and supportive environment.

Socialize in English
Enhance your ability to connect with others by learning a wide range of greeting words and phrases. Discover how to use both informal and formal language appropriately based on different situations. Practice expressing thoughts, feelings, and ideas to build meaningful connections and boost confidence in social interactions.
